text:
Marta Li: Heads up — console p99 for /v1/chat is oscillating again for some customers. p50/p95 steady. The spikes line up with minutes that have ~3-6 samples.
Omar Singh: small-n artifact. Are we showing per-minute merged tdigest or per-route then merged percentiles? we had different codepaths.
Marta Li: current query from console (last 2h, endpoint breakdown):
```
SELECT tdigest_percentile(0.99) as p99, sum(samples) as count
FROM telemetry.latency_rollup
WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' AND env='prod'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute DESC
```
Priya Patel: that's computing p99 on the merged tdigest blobs. If a route has 1-2 slow requests it'll blow up p99 after merge because tdigest is lossy with tiny inputs.
Sam (eng-platform): agreed — we need clearer provenance. UX suggestion: show p50/p95 prominently, hide p99 behind a small toggle and show a confidence chip (green/amber/red) based on sample_count and route-variance.
Omar Singh: backend idea: add sample_count and route_variance to the rollup (two ints/floats). Console can compute confidence cheaply off those. Avoid adding a new high-cardinality string tag.
Jules Park: route_variance = variance(p99_per_route) ? or variance of latencies across samples? prefer variance of p95/p99 across route variants so it highlights merge inversion risk.
Sam (eng-platform): implementation plan: store samples_total, routes_covered, p95_stddev_in_routes. For immediate fix: console flag to collapse p99 by default and overlay a heatmap of samples_per_minute (click to expand minute). Product team can opt-in if they want always-visible p99.
Marta Li: can we also annotate minutes where sample_total < 50 as "insufficient" and render a subtle dashed line for p99? that would stop product folks from treating tiny-sample spikes as incidents.
Priya Patel: yes. Also consider labeling where tdigest_compression_level < 100 as "low-fidelity" (we keep compression metadata in rollups).
Omar Singh: question for telemetry-bot: will adding samples_total & p95_stddev_in_routes increase rollup size much?
telemetry-bot: Telemetry schema change estimate: +2 numeric fields per rollup chunk (~0.5% storage increase). Backfill not required.
Sam (eng-platform): perfect. timeline: I'll open a console PR to hide p99 by default + sample heatmap widget. Omar — can you file a telemetry PR to add samples_total/routes_covered/p95_stddev_in_routes? link them here.
Omar Singh: filed telemetry#812. staging ETA 2024-06-12.
telemetry-bot: Telemetry PR telemetry#812 linked. CI checks passed.
Jules Park: once staging has heatmap I'll test with the tenant that showed oscillations and post screenshots. If it looks good we can flip flag in prod for the dashboards team.
Sam (eng-platform): noted. I'll add a short console tooltip: "p99 may be unreliable for small sample counts or high route variance. Click to view per-route p99s."
Marta Li: great, thank you. Small change but should cut false-alert noise. :relieved:
